description: This file defines the 'aCase' class, a model representing customer support cases within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, including properties, relationships, and methods for handling case data.

classes.name: aCase
classes.description: Represents a customer support case with properties, relationships, and methods for managing case data within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the case's name as its summary text.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Provides access control helper data for list views, including account access rights.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Saves related contact relationships for the case.

methods.name: set_case_contact_relationship
methods.description: Associates a contact with the case with a default role.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields like assigned user names and related account info.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts related to the case.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list view display, including status and priority labels.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a search WHERE clause based on a query string.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Sets email notification content with case details.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates support for specific interfaces, e.g., ACL.

methods.name: getEmailSubjectMacro
methods.description: Retrieves the macro used for email subject line parsing.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Fetches account info related to a specific case ID.
